SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. R.C.S.
S. B. D. 7682
Special Branch / Tan / 2 36
REPORT
Date December 15, 1936.
Subject Chief Detective Inspector Chen Tz Ching, Political Section, French Police, suspected of espionage by Chinese Police.
Made By ____ and ____ Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao-liang.

With reference to my report dated December 7 on the above subject, Chief Detective Inspector Chen Tz Ching of the Political Section, French Police, has approached Hwang Ching Yung for assistance in clearing up the allegations made against him. The latter called on Mr. Tu Yueh Sung who, in turn, communicated with Mr. C. C. Keng, French Secretary to Mayor Wu Te Chen. Through their joint efforts, Mayor Wu Te Chen has agreed to forward an explanation to the Nanking Government.

This no doubt will prove satisfactory, and the order for an investigation into the activities of the Chief Detective officer will probably be withdrawn.

Tan Shao-liang
Superintendent.

D. C. (Special Branch).

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE 15 DEC 1936）

报告
日期：1936年12月15日。
事由：法国巡捕房政治科首席侦探督察长陈子清，被中国警方怀疑从事间谍活动。
呈报人 ____ 及 ____ 由谭绍良 警司转呈。

关于我于12月7日就上述事由提交的报告，法国巡捕房政治科首席侦探督察长陈子清已向黄敬庸寻求协助，以澄清针对他的指控。后者拜访了杜月笙先生，杜先生随即与吴铁城市长的法文秘书耿嘉基（C. C. Keng）先生取得联系。通过他们的共同努力，吴铁城市长已同意向南京政府提交一份说明。

这无疑将令人满意，针对该首席侦探官员活动进行调查的命令可能会被撤销。

谭绍良
警司。

副警司（特别股）。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 1936年12月15日）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
**〔此处有黑色印章覆盖文字：SECRET〕**
REPORT

File No. H.W.S. ...
S. B. D. 7682
Special Branch / Station 2 3 C.
Date December 7, 1936.

Confidential

Subject Chief Detective Inspector Chen Tz Ching (陳子清), Political Section,
French Police, suspected of espionage by Chinese Authorities.

Made by .................... and .................... Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao-liang.

It has been rumoured during the past days that an
order has been received by the Public Safety Bureau from
Nanking to investigate an allegation that Chinese Chief
Detective Inspector Chen Tz Ching of the French Police has
been doing espionage work for the local Japanese Authorities.
Detective Inspector Chen has been in charge of the
Chinese Section of the Political Branch, French Police, for a
number of years and the recent allegation against him
apparently arose through his loyalty to the French Police
rather than to devotion to the Japanese. It appears that
this Chinese officer has been endeavouring to ascertain the
troop movements in various parts of China, especially as
regards their strength, the names of commanders and the places
at which they are to be stationed and in the course of his
enquiries he called on certain Chinese officials to seek
information.
This gave rise to a misunderstanding, particularly so
as the officer is a native of Kiangpeh (江北), and it is a
common belief among Chinese people that mostly natives of
Kiangpeh are working for Japanese as spies.
It is believed that the Public Safety Bureau will
forward a report explaining the circumstances and this will
clear the officer of all suspicion.
There are also rumours in circulation, and several
reports have been received to that effect by the P.S.B., that
the French Police are on extremely good terms with the local
Japanese Authorities.

（左侧批注：C.P.）
（左侧印章：MUNICIPAL POLICE / SHANGHAI RECEIVED / 7 DEC 1936）

（左侧手写批注：2/12）

Tan Searle
Superintendent.

D.C. (Special Branch).

报告

档案号 H.W.S ____ 
S. B. D. 7682
特别股 / 第2分区 3 C.
日期：1936年12月7日。

机密

事由：法国巡捕房政治科首席侦探督察长陈子清（陳子清），被中国当局怀疑从事间谍活动。

呈报人 ____ 及 ____ 由谭绍良 警司转呈。

近日有传闻称，公共安全局收到来自南京的命令，要求调查一项指控，即法国巡捕房的华人首席侦探督察长陈子清一直在为当地日本当局从事间谍工作。陈侦探督察长负责法国巡捕房政治科的华务股已有数年，近期针对他的指控显然源于他对法国巡捕房的忠诚，而非出于对日本的效忠。看来，这位华人警官一直试图查明中国各地的部队调动情况，特别是关于其兵力、指挥官姓名以及驻扎地点，并在查询过程中拜访了一些中国官员以寻求信息。

这引起了误解，尤其是因为该警官是江北（Kiangpeh）人，而在中国人中普遍存在一种看法，即大多数江北人都在为日本人做间谍。

相信公共安全局将提交一份报告解释相关情况，这将消除对该警官的所有嫌疑。

此外，还有谣言流传，公共安全局也收到了几份此类报告，称法国巡捕房与当地日本当局关系极为融洽。

（左侧批注：C.P.）
（左侧印章：公共租界警务处 / 上海收件 / 1936年12月7日）

（左侧手写批注：2/12）

谭西尔（Tan Searle）
警司。

副警司（特别股）。
